The module has one file, src/domain/task.ts, and everything in it belongs to the task-management domain. It defines the entities (User, Project, Task), the status values (taskStatuses and TaskStatus), the domain error type (DomainError), the filter used for queries (TaskFilter) and the repository port (TaskRepository).

Each rule is defined once. The allowed status values exist only in the taskStatuses const array, and TaskStatus is derived from it. Both Task.status and TaskFilter.status reuse TaskStatus instead of repeating the string values.

The repository port uses the module's own types throughout. Its methods take and return User, Project, Task and TaskFilter, with no outside or ad-hoc shapes.

One small design note: TaskRepository also handles users and projects, not just tasks. All three are in the same domain, so this does not split the file into unrelated concerns, and it is not a violation.

Import direction is out of scope and was not checked.
